title: Track radius: where no curve of 500 m fits the data

findings.info: junction: near a junction, no curve of 500 m (the floor) stays within 10 cm of the staged heights: held at it, the curve leaves that band by up to 26 cm (tightest 500 m). Following the data within the band, the radius would be 20 m.

answer_explanations.hold the radius: Keeps 500 m, as built: the rail stays up to 26 cm from the data here.
answer_explanations.follow the data: Lets the radius go below 500 m here, to 20 m, to stay within 10 cm of the data.
